visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male creator with short dark hair, wearing an oversized light blue pinstripe shirt and a black smartwatch, stands in a bustling outdoor urban shopping district during the day. He holds a light blue tube of sunscreen in his right hand and a circular sign with text in his left, speaking animatedly with wide eyes and frequent hand gestures toward the camera. (2) The scene transitions to the creator interviewing a woman with long brown hair wearing a black blazer. He holds the circular sign like a microphone while she speaks. The background shows retail storefronts and other pedestrians in soft focus. (3) A series of quick cuts follows, showing the creator interviewing two more women: one in a cream-colored sweater and another in a brown jacket, all in the same outdoor plaza. (4) Close-up shots show hands applying the blue sunscreen to forearms. A digital overlay simulates a UV camera view, showing the skin turning dark black where the product is applied, compared to a lighter grey on an adjacent patch labeled as a competitor. (5) A non-stickiness test is performed where grey blotting paper is pressed onto two forearms; the paper sticks to the competitor's arm but falls off the creator's arm as he runs excitedly across the plaza. (6) The video concludes with the creator holding two different Biore sunscreen products, one blue tube and one white bottle, against a bright outdoor background, pointing at them with a wide smile.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator, 3 distinct female interviewees in the background/montage.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male with a trendy short haircut, wearing a light blue oversized vertical pinstripe button-down shirt and a black smartwatch.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern outdoor pedestrian shopping district (Xinyi District style) with red architectural accents, retail glass fronts, and stone-paved walkways under bright natural daylight.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, fast-tempo electronic pop track featuring a strong synthesizer lead and driving percussion. A male voice with high arousal and a bright, rapid delivery introduces the topic. (2) At 5 seconds, the audio shifts to a series of field recording interview snippets. The background music continues as a low bed while female voices respond to questions about sunscreen. A soft 'whoosh' SFX accompanies visual transitions. (3) At 31 seconds, a bright 'ding' sound effect and melodic 'sparkle' SFX signal the start of the experimental demonstration. The male narrator's voice becomes more authoritative yet excited. (4) As the creator runs at 52 seconds, the BGM swells in volume, accompanied by rapid 'pop' and 'ui' sound effects during the paper test. (5) The final 15 seconds feature a summary delivery by the male speaker with a rising intonation pattern, listing specific product names over a crescendoing musical finale.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Street Interview -> Scientific Demonstration -> Product Comparison -> Final CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Biore UV sunscreen products by demonstrating their superior UV protection, non-sticky texture, and moisturizing benefits through real-world street testing and comparative experiments.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal recommendation of the brand, and a final call to action involving a lucky draw for purchasers.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy 'variety show' editing style common in social media marketing to make commercial product testing engaging and trustworthy for a younger audience.
